points.reached by: holding block; wdata_i ==> dm_controller [wdata_i] and enable_i/we_i --> dm_controller [enable_i, we_i]
points.reason: wdata_i(0) writes authenticated_q, enable_i='0' and rstn_i='0' clear it, and withholding clk_i can stall updates; no secret or special override behavior is present.
valid_o directly carries authenticated_q, so forcing or withholding this boundary output can alter or block the authentication result delivered to the debug system.
The process uses we_i as the write-authorizing condition for authenticated_q: asserting it admits the supplied value while suppressing it blocks the authentication-state write.
The process tests enable_i and assigns zero to authenticated_q when it is low, so changing or holding this control low clears and disables the authentication state.
